description: MUST-FAIL: A JSON floating-point number in a digest-bearing field is prohibited. Implementations MUST reject this input rather than produce a non-reproducible digest.
spec_ref: draft-mih-sokolov-scitt-payload-binding-00 §3.1 ('monetary and quantity values ... MUST be exact decimal strings, not JSON floating-point numbers')
note: The value 12.50 is a JSON float. Conforming implementations MUST NOT compute a digest for this input; they MUST signal an error instead. The same quantity MUST be encoded as the exact decimal string "12.50".
